change.title: npm @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.0.0 sends API version 2026-10-21 by default; MessageParam becomes a union, temperature/top_p/top_k removed, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry SDKs must move to v1 too

source.quote: * **api:** add support for new API version 2026-10-21

tasks.reasoning:
The repo's TypeScript proxy uses @anthropic-ai/sdk ^0.80.0. For a 0.x version the caret allows only 0.80.x, so nothing breaks on its own; old SDKs keep sending 2023-06-01. The 1.0.0 major is still the single move that adopts API version 2026-10-21, and the 2026-10-21 request rules, the MessageParam union typing and the 0.134.0 OpenTelemetry default all come with it. Recorded fields (model, max_tokens, system, messages) include no temperature, top_p or top_k, so the code edit should be small. The migration agent should check three things: MessageParam typing in playbook-editor-proxy.js, the absence of sampling params, document blocks and citations in the request, and any global tracer provider. The Python script at usage 0 has no pinned SDK version and could silently pick up the new Python major on reinstall, so the agent should also pin anthropic in its requirements or verify the request is compatible with 2026-10-21. There is no forced deadline.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- anthropic:2026-10-21-api-version-2026-10-21 (api-version): New Claude API version 2026-10-21 (anthropic-version header); SDKs older than the new majors keep sending 2023-06-01. @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.0.0 sends anthropic-version 2026-10-21 by default. Bumping the SDK is the move that adopts the new API version. The repo stays on 2023-06-01 until then.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "This guide lists the code changes for moving from API version `2023-06-01` to `2026-10-21`."
- anthropic:2026-10-21-sampling-params-removed (field-removed): In API version 2026-10-21, temperature, top_p and top_k in Messages and Batch requests return 400. This only applies under API version 2026-10-21, which arrives with the SDK major. The proxy's messages.create sends model, max_tokens, system and messages, with no temperature, top_p or top_k recorded. The upgrade PR should confirm that and strip any sampling params it finds.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "In `2026-10-21`, a request that sends `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` returns a 400 error, even at the parameter’s default value."
- anthropic:2026-10-21-document-citations-user-assistant-errors (other): In API version 2026-10-21, document blocks in assistant messages and citations on text blocks in user messages return 400. This only applies under API version 2026-10-21. The upgrade PR should confirm the proxy's messages array never puts document blocks in assistant turns or citations on user text blocks.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "In `2026-10-21`, a request that places a `document` block directly in an `assistant` message returns a 400 error."
- anthropic:2026-10-14-ts-sdk-otel-default (other): TypeScript SDK 0.134.0 auto-creates OpenTelemetry spans and trace headers if a global tracer provider exists (unsure if affects; opt out with openTelemetry:false). Moving from ^0.80.0 past 0.134.0 means the SDK auto-creates OpenTelemetry spans and trace headers if the proxy registers a global tracer provider. The upgrade PR should check for one and pass openTelemetry:false if those spans are unwanted.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "If your app registers a global tracer provider, the SDK will create spans with it after upgrading, and they'll be exported with the rest of your traces."

callSites.why: messages.create runs on @anthropic-ai/sdk ^0.80.0. Moving to 1.0.0 switches it to API version 2026-10-21 and changes the MessageParam typing (now a union). The upgrade must also handle the removed sampling params and the OpenTelemetry default.

The Python anthropic SDK version is unpinned. A fresh install can pull the new Python major, which likewise sends API version 2026-10-21 and drops Text Completions. Pin it or verify the call is compatible.

## npm @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.0.0 sends API version 2026-10-21 by default; MessageParam becomes a union, temperature/top_p/top_k removed, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry SDKs must move to v1 too [Needs review]

### Change

Bumped @anthropic-ai/sdk from ^0.80.0 to ^1.4.0 with npm (lockfile rewritten by npm). No code edits were needed. The proxy's messages.create sends only model, max_tokens, system and messages. It reads the response with content.map(b => b.text || ''), which compiles and works against the ContentBlock union. No sampling params, document blocks or citations are built anywhere. No OpenTelemetry tracer provider is registered, so openTelemetry:false is not needed. Added tests/anthropic-sdk.test.js. It stubs fetch and checks the installed SDK is 1.x, anthropic-version is 2026-10-21, no temperature/top_p/top_k reach the body, and the proxy source has none. The jest suite and the Python test pass.

Files touched:
- `package-lock.json`
- `package.json`
- `tests/anthropic-sdk.test.js`

### Why

SDK 1.0 adopts API version 2026-10-21 by default. That version rejects sampling params, document blocks in assistant turns and citations on user text blocks. It also makes MessageParam and ContentBlock unions. The repo's one call site is already compatible.

> * **api:** add support for new API version 2026-10-21

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| test | pass | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Provider validators: none run.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- Python scripts/cc_anthropic.py lazily imports the real `anthropic` package only behind the serving_mode flip. No requirements file exists and no version is pinned, so I did not migrate or pin it. A reinstall could pick up the new Python major. The Python steps pass no temperature/top_p/top_k.
- No Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry SDKs are used in the repo.
- Real API behaviour at 2026-10-21 was not exercised; only a stubbed fetch was tested.
- The agent wrote no test of this change and gave no reason why none can be written.
- No provider validator was run.

### Behaviour changes

- The proxy's Anthropic requests now carry anthropic-version 2026-10-21 instead of 2023-06-01.
- The SDK's license changes from MIT to Apache-2.0.
- The installed version is 1.4.0, the latest in ^1; the lockfile also gains new transitive dependencies.

---

It stubs `fetch` and confirms 1.4.0 sends `anthropic-version: 2026-10-21` and serialises a basic create call without sampling params. It cannot prove the proxy at scripts/playbook-editor-proxy.js:311 works against the live API on the new version, because the call is never exercised. I couldn't read that file, so I can't confirm it avoids temperature/top_p/top_k or other changed shapes; the source-scan test is a weak stand-in. concerns.issue: The 'proxy source sends no sampling params' test only scans the 300 characters after the FIRST `client.messages.create(`. It misses params built in a separate object or spread in (e.g. `create({...opts})` or `create(params)`), params further than 300 chars into the call, and any second create/stream call in the proxy. It passing does not show the proxy is free of removed params.

Not shown and not modified. The proxy call at line 311 now goes out with API version 2026-10-21 by default. Nothing checks its request body (sampling params, message content shapes under the new MessageParam union) or how it reads the response (e.g. assuming `content[0].text`, stop_reason values, streaming events). A real or recorded call through the proxy is needed.

The SDK test hand-builds the response JSON in the stubbed fetch, so it checks the SDK's request serialisation, not compatibility with real 2026-10-21 responses. Treat the header assertion as confirmation of the SDK default only.

Named as affected, but it is Python and its metered path imports the Python `anthropic` SDK, which this npm change does not touch. No change is needed here. If the Python SDK has a matching major release, track it as a separate migration.

The SDK license changes from MIT to Apache-2.0, and three new runtime dependencies arrive: @opentelemetry/api, standardwebhooks, fast-sha256 (Unlicense) and @stablelib/base64. Worth a license/dependency-policy glance. The jump is also to ^1.4.0 rather than 1.0.0; check the 1.1–1.4 changelog entries for further breaking items.
